gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the lithium battery in a solar camera can't charge below 0°C (32°F), so in a freezing winter the panel can't refill it however sunny it is. Reolink says the built-in battery 'cannot charge properly when the temperature is below 0°C' and gives its charging range as 0°C to 45°C. Its fix is the Solar Panel 2S, whose own 5,900 mAh / 42.48 Wh battery charges down to -10°C. Separately, most battery solar cameras record only when motion triggers them, not 24/7.
standout_why: In both saved chats ChatGPT ran no searches and got no results, so there were no rival pages to read. I compared against its answer as the shopper saw it. That answer says size the battery 'for several cloudy days' and pick 'Motion-triggered or continuous, as needed'. It never mentions the freezing-point charging cutoff. It also wrongly suggests continuous recording is an ordinary choice, when Reolink says its battery cameras 'typically do not support continuous recording due to power limitations' and names only the Altas series, TrackMix LTE Plus / Plus 2 and Battery Video Doorbell (2nd) as exceptions.
decides: Two physical limits decide whether the plan works. (1) Cold: if nights or days stay below 32°F, a standard 3 W, 6 W or 12 W solar panel stops charging the camera's lithium cell. A shopper in a freezing climate needs a panel with its own cold-rated battery (Reolink Solar Panel 2S, charges to -10°C) or wired power, so the 'bigger panel' advice ChatGPT gave doesn't fix this. (2) Recording: a shopper who wants 24/7 footage must pick a large-battery model built for it, such as the Reolink Altas PT Ultra (72 Wh, about 96 h non-stop on a full charge at 3 fps), not the Argus 4 Pro, whose spec lists only 'Triggered recording'. Everyone else should expect motion clips only.
candidates: Reolink Argus 4 Pro + Solar Panel 2 (6 W)
Reolink Argus Eco Ultra + Reolink 6 W Solar Panel

findings.label: Lithium battery charging below freezing
findings.note: Maker's words, step 3 of its troubleshooting list: 'The camera's built-in lithium battery cannot charge properly when the temperature is below 0°C.' No article date shown.

findings.label: Recommended charging temperature range
findings.value: 0°C to 45°C (32°F to 113°F); do not use the camera below -10°C (14°F)
findings.source_title: Introduction to the Working Environment of Reolink Solar Panels
findings.note: One range for all Reolink panels. The article says temperatures below -10°C 'will significantly slow down the chemical reaction' of the batteries. No article date shown.

findings.label: Cold-weather charging and built-in buffer battery
findings.value: Battery cells charge at temperatures as low as -10°C; built-in battery 5,900 mAh / 42.48 Wh; 6 W panel; works between -10°C and 50°C
findings.note: The panel charges its own wide-temperature cells, then powers the camera directly instead of charging it, which gets around the camera battery's 0°C limit. The FAQ names Argus 4 Pro and Altas PT Ultra as compatible. No US price shown on the page.

findings.label: 24/7 continuous recording support
findings.value: Typically not supported; exceptions: Altas series, TrackMix LTE Plus, TrackMix LTE Plus 2, Battery Video Doorbell (2nd)
findings.source_title: Can Battery Powered Cameras Support 24/7 Record (Reolink Support)
findings.note: Quote: 'Reolink Battery-powered cameras typically do not support continuous recording due to power limitations.' Reolink credits the exceptions to expanded battery capacity and software.

findings.label: Recording mode, battery and temperature
findings.value: Triggered recording only (no continuous mode listed); 5,000 mAh battery; operating -10°C to 55°C (14°F to 131°F); Wi-Fi 2.4/5 GHz; kit panel Solar Panel 2 (6 W)
findings.note: Spec table. No charging temperature is listed on the product page; the support pages above give 0°C.

findings.label: Battery, recording modes and sunlight need
findings.value: 3.6 V 20,000 mAh = 72 Wh; motion, schedule and continuous recording; operating -20°C to 55°C; 'Just 5 hours of direct sunlight daily (with Solar Panel 2)'
findings.note: The spec table reads '24/4 recording', apparently a typo; the FAQ describes a Continuous Recording Mode that records 'day and night without waiting for motion triggers'. No US price shown on the page.

findings.label: Non-stop recording on a full charge
findings.value: About 96 hours at the default 3 fps Low Frame Rate
findings.source_title: How Long Does the Battery Last for Reolink TrackMix LTE Plus and Reolink Altas Series
findings.note: Arithmetic: 72 Wh / 96 h ≈ 0.75 W average, about 18 Wh a day that the panel must replace. The same page gives about 8 days for the Altas, about 48 h for the TrackMix LTE Plus (Standard Mode) and about 72 h for it in Smart Battery Mode.
